meta.name: Close the support loop and send CSAT between Jira, Gmail, WhatsApp and HubSpot

parameters.content:
## Load & normalize

Execute Workflow trigger, load config, normalize create payload, can-send check.

## Send auto-reply

Route WhatsApp vs Gmail and send the customer acknowledgement message.

## HubSpot note

Optional HubSpot note create + associate when contact ID is present.

## Mark auto-reply sent

Jira comment + label to record that auto-reply was sent on the ticket.

## Webhook intake

Jira Done webhook, token validation, CSAT form path config, parse payload.

## Fetch & enrich

GET Jira issue, enrich channel/contact data, decide if CSAT can be sent.

## Send CSAT ask

Build CSAT form URL and send via WhatsApp or Gmail on the same channel.

## Mark CSAT sent

Jira comment + label after CSAT request message was sent.

## Form intake

CSAT Form Trigger receives score; Normalize validates ticket from URL param.

## Jira lookup

Fetch and parse Jira issue to confirm ticket exists before saving score.

## Save to Jira

Write CSAT comment, optional custom field score, then form ending node.

## HubSpot sync

Optional HubSpot CSAT note when contact ID exists on the ticket.

## AI Customer Support — Close-Loop

Post-ticket comms in 3 paths: **Create** · **Done webhook** · **CSAT form**. Each white box = one step group (left → right).

**After re-import:** paste CSAT Form Trigger URL path into **CSAT Form Path Config** node.
